messages:
laura: Heads-up — saw a small but consistent billing delta for streaming requests that get prefetch + the sampling grace window. Looks like ~2-3 provisional tokens per reconnect in some traces.

mike: Can you paste an example trace? rough numbers are fine.

laura: Sure. snippet from prod trace: 
```
req_id=tx-9a1b
route=us-west-2-prefetch
model=gptx-8k
initial_tokens=42
stream_chunks=5
reconnect=1
provisional_charge=45
confirmed_charge=42
notes=soft-trim on reconnect applied after partial toolcall
```

sophie: This reads like a race between the prefetch heartbeat and the graceful sampling window. If prefetch issues a small toolcall while the stream reconnects we end up double-counting the suffix.

raman: Agree. Also our telemetry labels don't include whether a chunk came from prefetch vs user-requested stream in the ledger. Console shows "provisional" but doesn't surface route+prefetch tag which makes reconciliation hard.

mike: Oof. So two problems: (1) runtime double-count heuristic, (2) observability+console UX. Which do we want prioritized?

laura: runtime first. if we can avoid provisional tokens being issued for prefetch fragments during reconnect, that should fix most of the customer-exposed noise.

olivia: For product: customers keep DMing support about small recurring 0.01-0.05 spikes. They don't trust provisional labeling. Can we make console show source: prefetch | user | toolcall ?

raman: We can. Minimal change: add metadata tag `source=background_prefetch` to ledger entries, and expose it in the token waterfall. We'll need a small API bump where the router attaches source tags to resume/heartbeat events.

sophie: Runtime fix idea: treat any in-flight reconnect that has a matching session id + overlapping prefix as idempotent and avoid emitting provisional credits for prefetch-origin chunks. Pseudocode: 
```
if chunk.source == prefetch and session.has_active_prefix(chunk.prefix):
    mark chunk as deduped // no provisional credit
else:
    emit provisional_credit(chunk)
```
Pros: no change to client API. Cons: requires robust prefix matching (off-by-one risks).

mike: Prefix matching worries me. We've had off-by-one leading to lost credits before. Could we instead add a short TTL on provisional credits emitted from prefetch (e.g., refund if confirmed within 1s) and perform automatic reconciliation in ledger?

laura: TTL-refund path sounds safer. Workflow: emit provisional_credit with tag `prefetch`, wait 1s for confirmation event; if confirmed within TTL, convert to confirmed; else keep provisional but mark for operator review. That reduces double-charge window.

raman: Implementation note: our current ledger compaction job doesn't keep provisional->confirmed linkage for prefetched tokens. We'd have to add a link_id field. Minimal schema change: add `link_id` string to provisional entries.

olivia: From UX: when a charge converts within TTL, don't show a toast or ticket. Only show a flag if it remains provisional after TTL. That should cut support noise.

billing-bot: ALERT: provisional-prefetch-spike threshold breached in us-west-2 at 2026-03-22T09:12Z (count=128, threshold=100) :warning:

mike: Billing bot confirms it's happening now. Laura, can you open an engineering ticket with the trace and the suggested TTL-refund approach? Add a note to update console waterfall to show `source` and hide ephemeral provisional conversions.

laura: Will do. @olivia can you add product acceptance criteria (support messaging + console change)?

olivia: Yep. Criteria: 1) ledger exposes `source` for every provisional/confirmed entry, 2) console waterfall filters by source, 3) provisional credits from `prefetch` auto-resolve silently within TTL, 4) support FAQ updated.

sophie: I'll prototype a unit test for the TTL-refund behavior (simulate reconnect + prefetch overlap).

raman: I'll draft the minimal schema migration (link_id + source tag) and estimate rollout complexity for Dedicated/Private. Should be compatible if we default the new fields to null.

mike: Great. Assign owners and timeline? Let's aim for a small canary in staging this week, production next week if no regressions.

laura: Filed ENG-4321 with traces + proposal. assigning to sophie (runtime) and raman (telemetry). I'll link to product ticket PRD-987.

billing-bot: Note: automatic refund conversions will create higher churn in ledger write-amplification; ops-eta on compaction update required.

olivia: Thanks all. Once ENG-4321 has PRs, we'll schedule console changes.

mike: Thanks — good plan. :thumbsup:
